title: Glossier You Soie Eau de Parfum
descriptionHtml:
✓ Fresh Scent✓ Layerable Scent✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Unisex/Genderless Scent
Fragrance Family: Fresh

Scent Type: Fresh Solar

Key Notes: Rice Milk, Tiare Water, Ambrox, Evening Jasmine

Fragrance Description: A fresh solar take on the classic Glossier You skin-scent enhancer, Soie Eau de Parfum smells different on everyone. Fresh bergamot opens the fragrance, followed by a creamy, solar floral heart of rice milk, Tiare water, and evening jasmine, all heightened by a warm, musky Ambrox base. Mostly, it smells intimate, floral, sensual, velvety, and sheer.

About the Fragrance: Soie captures the sensuality of stepping into yourself—where day blends into dusk and sun-kissed skin meets cool evening air. A silky, solar floral that takes you from day to night with its transitional, fluid, an
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Spray scent as desired on your pulse points: your neck, behind your ears, your wrists, and more.
-Allow fragrance to settle for a few moments rather than rubbing it in as this can disrupt the scent.
-Apply post-shower, after moisturizing to aid absorption for a longer, stronger scent impact.
Ingredients+
Alcohol Denat., Fragrance/Parfum, Water/Aqua/Eau, Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes, Hexamethylindanopyran, Pelargonium Graveolens Flower Oil, Santalum Album Oil, Vanillin, Benzyl Salicylate, Trimethylcyclopentenyl Methylisopentenol, Santalol, Coumarin, Citronellol, Farnesol, Linalool, Benzaldehyde, Pinene, Limonene, Beta-Caryophyllene.
